nice_guideline_used: NICE NG107 / NG203 (Renal replacement therapy and conservative management / CKD assessment and management)

medications.dose: 2.5 mg PO once daily (titrate to 5 mg after 2‑4 weeks, then up to 10 mg as tolerated)
medications.purpose: Control hypertension, reduce proteinuria and provide renoprotection
medications.nice_justification: NG107/NG203 – ACE inhibitor recommended for CKD with proteinuria (ACR ≥30 mg/mmol) and hypertension

medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually and discontinue if eGFR falls <20 mL/min/1.73 m²
medications.purpose: Slow CKD progression and reduce cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE TA775 / NG203 – SGLT2 inhibitor indicated for CKD with eGFR 20‑45 mL/min/1.73 m², irrespective of diabetes status

medications.dose: 20 mg PO once daily in the evening
medications.purpose: Cardiovascular risk reduction in CKD (risk‑equivalent to IHD)
medications.nice_justification: NG203 – Statin recommended for all CKD patients for CV risk reduction

contraindications.reason: Can worsen renal function and cause fluid retention in CKD stage 4
Risk of lactic acidosis when eGFR is below 30
contraindications.alternative: Consider dose‑adjusted metformin only if eGFR 30‑45, otherwise use alternative glucose‑lowering agents

contraindications.reason: Increased risk of hyperkalaemia and acute kidney injury; NICE advises against dual RAAS blockade
contraindications.alternative: Use a single ACE‑I (Ramipril) as prescribed

assumptions_warnings: Exact eGFR not provided – assumed ≥20 mL/min/1.73 m² based on creatinine values; will confirm before starting dapagliflozin
Baseline serum potassium, liver function tests, and lipid panel not available – will obtain before initiating Ramipril and Atorvastatin
Hb, ferritin, TSAT, and iron studies not available – anemia management (ESA or IV iron) will be considered after labs
Phosphate, calcium, PTH, and bicarbonate not available – CKD‑MBD treatment will be guided by those results
Allergy history not documented – will verify no ACE‑I or statin hypersensitivity before prescribing
treatment_summary: Start ramipril for blood pressure control and proteinuria reduction, add dapagliflozin to slow CKD progression, and initiate atorvastatin for cardiovascular risk reduction. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, and lipid profile as per NICE NG107/NG203. Avoid NSAIDs, metformin (if eGFR <30), and dual ACE‑I/ARB therapy. Further investigations (eGFR, potassium, Hb, iron studies, CKD‑MBD panel) are required to refine anemia and mineral‑bone management.
